in_marathi.name: Bhagtej
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagtej हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagtej is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Bhagati, which means 'devotee' or 'worshiper'. The name Bhagtej is used to signify the one who is the lord of wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Bhagtej is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, who is considered the preserver of the universe and the giver of all wealth and blessings. The name is also considered auspicious and is bestowed upon children to bring them prosperity and good fortune.
